brief: Recognizable original landmarks artistically integrated into premium blue and white OnzeTrots brush/grunge compositions. Artistic compositing is intentional; no pixel-identical claim.

assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / premium sports-brand background art.
Image 1: authoritative photographic reference for the recognizable Duindorp landmark.
Image 2: OnzeTrots website visual identity reference ONLY, not a source of buildings.
Create a fully art-directed premium 16:9 landscape blue-and-white OnzeTrots background for a football club LED screen. The user wants a beautifully composed artwork, not a literal photograph with a frame or a simple blue filter. Integrate the recognizable landmark into energetic layers of hand-painted royal-blue dry-brush strokes, white gesso, subtle navy ink, weathered paper fibres, screen-print grain and carefully placed paint splatter. Photograph-derived architectural likeness is important: the same distinctive silhouette, proportions, roof/arch form and perspective should be immediately recognizable. You may artistically crop, isolate, reposition and fade the scene into paint to build a strong composition. Do not obsess over pixel identity. Preserve landmark identity and real geographic features; do not invent a substitute landmark or import the clubhouse from image 2.
Art direction: sophisticated contemporary Dutch football identity, editorial collage, confident asymmetric composition, gorgeous brushwork with depth and clean tonal separation. Let the scene dissolve naturally into torn ink and rough paint, not a rectangular photo panel. Rich saturated club blue #03438a / #004bac, tiny deep navy accents, predominantly white chalky paper. Broad deliberate brush strokes, fine detailed grunge, luxurious tactile finish, crisp recognizable focal landmark. Balance energetic painted areas with a generous quiet white central/upper area for later live score and heading overlays. No enclosing photo frame, no all-over uniform noise, no generic gradients, no extra landmarks. No new text, slogans, scores, badge, mockup or UI. Any lettering already physically on the landmark may remain. Produce one complete polished full-bleed background, highest-quality detailed rendering, wide 16:9 composition.
Landmark and composition: Feature the exact Duindorp S.V. clubhouse façade, diagonal roofline, blue-white DUINDORP S.V. sign and crest, window grid, bare trees and terrace rail from image 1. Anchor the recognizably same façade in the lower-left two-thirds of the artwork, merging its edges with powerful blue and white brush sweeps. Keep the sign readable, keep the original architectural proportions. Upper middle/right remains airy white with delicate paper texture, suitable for a scoreboard. No unrelated buildings.
